1.prompt: What is the main goal of the Bubble Sort algorithm?
1.promptFa: هدف اصلی الگوریتم مرتب‌سازی حبابی (Bubble Sort) چیست؟

options.text: Sorting an array by repeatedly comparing and swapping adjacent elements
options.textFa: مرتب کردن یک آرایه با مقایسه و جابه‌جایی مکرر عناصر مجاور

options.text: Searching for a specific element in an array
options.textFa: جستجوی یک عنصر مشخص در یک آرایه

options.text: Splitting an array into smaller subarrays and merging them
options.textFa: تقسیم یک آرایه به زیرآرایه‌های کوچک‌تر و ادغام دوباره‌ی آن‌ها

options.text: Finding the shortest path between two nodes
options.textFa: پیدا کردن کوتاه‌ترین مسیر بین دو گره

1.explanation: Bubble Sort repeatedly compares each pair of adjacent elements and swaps them if they are in the wrong order, gradually sorting the array.
1.explanationFa: مرتب‌سازی حبابی به‌طور مکرر هر جفت از عناصر مجاور را با هم مقایسه می‌کند و اگر ترتیبشان اشتباه بود جایشان را عوض می‌کند، و به این ترتیب آرایه رفته‌رفته مرتب می‌شود.

1.prompt: Is this Bubble Sort implementation stable — does it preserve the relative order of equal elements?

options.text: Yes — it only swaps when arr[j] is strictly greater than arr[j + 1], so equal elements are never swapped past each other
No — swapping adjacent elements always breaks stability
Only when the array has no duplicate values
Only if the input is already sorted before running

1.explanation: The swap condition is arr[j] > arr[j + 1], a strict inequality. Two equal elements never satisfy that condition, so they never trade places — their original left-to-right order survives.

O(log n) — proportional to the recursion depth

Because Merge Sort does not use recursion
Both algorithms need the same amount of extra memory

1.explanation: Merge Sort's merge step combines two sorted halves into a new sequence, which needs somewhere to build that sequence before copying it back. Bubble Sort never separates the array at all — it just exchanges neighboring cells in place.
